title: About Kawan
en: I'm Kawan, your home companion. I watch for falls and long periods without movement, remind you about your medicines, keep track of the readings you enter, explain about 100 health topics in simple words, with sources, and contact your caregiver if something seems wrong. I'm not a doctor and I can't diagnose. Open 'How to use' at the top of the screen for a full guide.
ms: Saya Kawan, peneman di rumah anda. Saya memantau jika anda terjatuh atau lama tidak bergerak, mengingatkan anda tentang ubat, merekod bacaan yang anda masukkan, menerangkan kira-kira 100 topik kesihatan dengan mudah beserta sumbernya, dan menghubungi penjaga anda jika ada yang tidak kena. Saya bukan doktor. Buka 'Cara guna' di bahagian atas skrin untuk panduan penuh.

title: Camera and privacy
en: Your camera video never leaves this device and is never recorded. The app only looks at 33 body-position points, such as shoulders and hips, to notice falls or long stillness. Turn on 'Privacy mode' to hide the video and show only a stick figure. A photo is sent only when you tap 'Check my medicine'.
ms: Video kamera anda tidak pernah keluar dari peranti ini dan tidak dirakam. Aplikasi hanya melihat 33 titik kedudukan badan, seperti bahu dan pinggul, untuk mengesan jatuh atau tidak bergerak terlalu lama. Hidupkan 'Mod privasi' untuk menyembunyikan video. Gambar hanya dihantar apabila anda menekan 'Semak ubat saya'.

title: Hello
en: Hello! I'm here with you. How are you feeling today? You can ask me about your medicines or a health topic, or say "daily check-in".
ms: Hai! Saya ada di sini bersama anda. Bagaimana perasaan anda hari ini? Anda boleh tanya tentang ubat atau topik kesihatan, atau sebut "semakan harian".

title: Thank you
en: You're very welcome. I'm always here if you need me.
ms: Sama-sama. Saya sentiasa ada jika anda perlukan saya.

title: Type 2 diabetes
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (6th ed., 2020); WHO Diabetes fact sheet
en: Type 2 diabetes means your body doesn't use insulin well, so sugar builds up in your blood. Over time, high sugar can damage the eyes, kidneys, nerves, feet and heart. Taking your medicines as prescribed, eating balanced meals, staying active, not smoking, and going to your regular check-ups all help. Your doctor will set your personal sugar and HbA1c targets.
ms: Diabetes jenis 2 bermaksud badan tidak menggunakan insulin dengan baik, jadi gula terkumpul dalam darah. Lama-kelamaan gula tinggi boleh merosakkan mata, buah pinggang, saraf, kaki dan jantung. Makan ubat seperti dipreskripsi, makan seimbang, aktif bergerak, tidak merokok dan hadir pemeriksaan berkala membantu. Doktor akan menetapkan sasaran gula dan HbA1c anda.

title: Low blood sugar (hypoglycaemia)
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (6th ed., 2020); American Diabetes Association; NHS
en: Low blood sugar, usually below 4 mmol/L, can cause shaking, sweating, hunger, a fast heartbeat, confusion or feeling faint. If this happens, take 15 to 20 grams of fast sugar, such as half a glass of fruit juice or a regular soft drink, or 3 to 4 sweets. Wait 15 minutes and check again, then eat a snack or meal. If you become confused, can't swallow safely, or don't improve, call 999. Always tell your doctor about low sugar episodes.
ms: Gula darah rendah, biasanya bawah 4 mmol/L, boleh menyebabkan menggigil, berpeluh, lapar, jantung berdebar, keliru atau rasa nak pitam. Jika berlaku, ambil 15 hingga 20 gram gula cepat, seperti separuh gelas jus buah atau minuman ringan biasa, atau 3 hingga 4 biji gula-gula. Tunggu 15 minit dan periksa semula, kemudian makan snek atau hidangan. Jika keliru, sukar menelan atau tidak bertambah baik, hubungi 999.

title: High blood sugar
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (6th ed., 2020); NHS
en: High blood sugar can make you very thirsty, pass urine often, feel tired or have blurred vision. Drink water, take your medicines as prescribed, and check your sugar if you have a meter. Get urgent medical help if readings stay very high, or if you have vomiting, fast deep breathing, drowsiness or confusion.
ms: Gula darah tinggi boleh menyebabkan sangat dahaga, kerap kencing, letih atau penglihatan kabur. Minum air, makan ubat seperti dipreskripsi dan periksa gula jika ada meter. Dapatkan bantuan perubatan segera jika bacaan kekal sangat tinggi, atau ada muntah, nafas laju dan dalam, mengantuk atau keliru.

title: HbA1c test
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (6th ed., 2020)
en: HbA1c shows your average blood sugar over roughly the last 2 to 3 months. Your doctor uses it to see how well your diabetes plan is working and sets a personal target based on your age and health. It is usually checked every 3 to 6 months.
ms: HbA1c menunjukkan purata gula darah anda dalam kira-kira 2 hingga 3 bulan lepas. Doktor menggunakannya untuk melihat keberkesanan rawatan diabetes dan menetapkan sasaran peribadi berdasarkan umur dan kesihatan anda. Biasanya diperiksa setiap 3 hingga 6 bulan.

title: Insulin storage and use
en: Keep unopened insulin in the fridge, never the freezer. The pen you are using can usually stay at room temperature for the time stated on its leaflet, often about 4 weeks, away from heat and direct sun. Rotate injection sites, and never share pens or needles. If you're unwell and not eating, don't simply stop insulin; ask your healthcare team what to do.
ms: Simpan insulin yang belum dibuka dalam peti sejuk, bukan peti beku. Pen yang sedang digunakan biasanya boleh disimpan pada suhu bilik mengikut tempoh dalam risalahnya, selalunya kira-kira 4 minggu, jauh dari haba dan cahaya matahari. Tukar tempat suntikan dan jangan berkongsi pen atau jarum. Jika sakit dan tidak makan, jangan berhenti insulin sendiri; tanya pasukan kesihatan anda.

title: Foot care with diabetes
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Diabetic Foot (2nd ed., 2018); NHS
en: Diabetes can reduce feeling in the feet, so small cuts may go unnoticed. Check your feet every day, using a mirror or a family member's help. Wash and dry well between the toes, never walk barefoot, and wear comfortable shoes. See a doctor promptly for any wound, redness, swelling, or a sore that isn't healing.
ms: Diabetes boleh mengurangkan rasa di kaki, jadi luka kecil mungkin tidak disedari. Periksa kaki setiap hari, dengan cermin atau bantuan ahli keluarga. Basuh dan keringkan celah jari, jangan berjalan tanpa kasut, dan pakai kasut yang selesa. Jumpa doktor segera jika ada luka, kemerahan, bengkak atau luka yang tidak sembuh.

title: Eye checks with diabetes
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (6th ed., 2020)
en: Diabetes can damage the back of the eye, the retina, often without early symptoms. That's why people with diabetes are advised to have a retinal eye screening when diagnosed and then regularly, usually once a year. See a doctor quickly for sudden vision loss, many new floaters, or a curtain over your vision.
ms: Diabetes boleh merosakkan bahagian belakang mata, iaitu retina, selalunya tanpa simptom awal. Sebab itu pesakit diabetes dinasihatkan menjalani saringan retina semasa didiagnosis dan kemudian secara berkala, biasanya setahun sekali. Jumpa doktor segera jika penglihatan hilang tiba-tiba atau seperti ada tirai menutup penglihatan.

title: High blood pressure (hypertension)
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Hypertension (5th ed., 2018); WHO Hypertension fact sheet
en: High blood pressure often has no symptoms, but over time it strains the heart, brain and kidneys. Take your medicines every day, even when you feel well. Reduce salt from kicap, budu, instant noodles and processed food. Stay active, keep a healthy weight, limit alcohol and don't smoke. Your doctor will set your target. A reading of 180/120 or higher, especially with chest pain, severe headache, weakness or confusion, needs urgent help.
ms: Darah tinggi selalunya tiada simptom, tetapi lama-kelamaan membebankan jantung, otak dan buah pinggang. Makan ubat setiap hari walaupun rasa sihat. Kurangkan garam daripada kicap, budu, mi segera dan makanan diproses. Aktif bergerak, jaga berat badan dan jangan merokok. Doktor akan menetapkan sasaran anda. Bacaan 180/120 atau lebih, terutamanya dengan sakit dada atau sakit kepala teruk, perlu bantuan segera.

title: Measuring blood pressure at home
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Hypertension (5th ed., 2018)
en: For an accurate home reading, sit and rest for 5 minutes with your back supported, feet flat and arm resting at heart level. Avoid coffee, smoking or exercise for 30 minutes before. Use the right cuff size on bare skin. Take 2 readings 1 minute apart and record both. You can enter them in Kawan under 'My readings' so your doctor sees the trend.
ms: Untuk bacaan tepat di rumah, duduk berehat 5 minit dengan belakang disokong, kaki rata dan lengan di paras jantung. Elakkan kopi, merokok atau senaman 30 minit sebelumnya. Guna saiz kaf yang betul pada kulit. Ambil 2 bacaan dengan jarak 1 minit dan catat kedua-duanya. Anda boleh masukkan dalam Kawan di 'Bacaan saya'.

title: Dizziness when standing up
en: Feeling dizzy when you stand up can happen when blood pressure drops briefly. Common causes include not drinking enough, some blood pressure medicines, and being unwell. Get up slowly: sit on the edge of the bed for a minute first. Drink enough water unless your doctor limits fluids. Tell your doctor if it keeps happening, and get help quickly if you faint or have chest pain.
ms: Rasa pening ketika bangun berdiri boleh berlaku apabila tekanan darah turun seketika. Puncanya termasuk kurang minum air, sesetengah ubat darah tinggi dan sedang sakit. Bangun perlahan-lahan: duduk di tepi katil seminit dahulu. Minum air yang cukup kecuali doktor menghadkan cecair. Beritahu doktor jika kerap berlaku, dan dapatkan bantuan segera jika pengsan atau sakit dada.

title: Stroke warning signs
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Ischaemic Stroke; NHS: Stroke; National Stroke Association of Malaysia (NASAM)
en: Remember BE-FAST. B is sudden loss of balance. E is sudden trouble with the eyes or vision. F is face drooping. A is arm or leg weakness. S is slurred or strange speech. T means time to call 999. Treatment works best within the first few hours. Note the time the symptoms started, and don't drive yourself.
ms: Ingat BE-FAST. B ialah hilang imbangan tiba-tiba. E ialah masalah mata atau penglihatan tiba-tiba. F ialah muka senget. A ialah tangan atau kaki lemah. S ialah percakapan pelat atau pelik. T bermaksud masa untuk hubungi 999. Rawatan paling berkesan dalam beberapa jam pertama. Catat masa simptom bermula dan jangan memandu sendiri.

title: Heart attack warning signs
source: American Heart Association; NHS: Heart attack
en: Heart attack signs include chest pain, pressure or tightness that may spread to the arm, jaw, neck or back. It can come with shortness of breath, sweating, nausea or feeling faint. Women, older adults and people with diabetes may have milder or unusual symptoms. If you have these, call 999 immediately. Don't wait to see if it passes.
ms: Tanda serangan jantung termasuk sakit, tekanan atau rasa ketat di dada yang mungkin merebak ke lengan, rahang, leher atau belakang. Ia boleh disertai sesak nafas, berpeluh, loya atau rasa nak pitam. Wanita, warga emas dan pesakit diabetes mungkin mengalami simptom yang lebih ringan. Jika ada, hubungi 999 segera.

title: Heart failure: daily self-care
source: NHS: Heart failure; European Society of Cardiology patient guidance
en: With heart failure the heart pumps less strongly, so fluid can build up. Weigh yourself every morning after the toilet and before breakfast. Tell your doctor or nurse if your weight rises suddenly; many teams use about 2 kg in 3 days as a warning sign, but follow the number your team gives you. Also tell them about more swelling or breathlessness, especially when lying flat. Follow any fluid or salt limits you were given.
ms: Dalam kegagalan jantung, jantung mengepam kurang kuat, jadi cecair boleh terkumpul. Timbang berat setiap pagi selepas ke tandas dan sebelum sarapan. Beritahu doktor atau jururawat jika berat naik mendadak; ramai menggunakan kira-kira 2 kg dalam 3 hari sebagai tanda amaran, tetapi ikut angka yang diberi oleh pasukan anda. Beritahu juga jika bengkak atau sesak nafas bertambah, terutamanya ketika berbaring.

title: Atrial fibrillation (irregular heartbeat)
en: Atrial fibrillation is an irregular, often fast heartbeat. It raises the risk of stroke, which is why many people with it take a blood thinner. You might feel palpitations, tiredness or breathlessness, or nothing at all. Take your medicines exactly as prescribed. Get urgent help for chest pain, fainting, severe breathlessness or any stroke sign.
ms: Fibrilasi atrium ialah degupan jantung yang tidak teratur dan selalunya laju. Ia meningkatkan risiko strok, sebab itu ramai pesakitnya mengambil ubat cair darah. Anda mungkin rasa berdebar, letih atau sesak nafas, atau tiada apa-apa. Ambil ubat tepat seperti dipreskripsi. Dapatkan bantuan segera jika sakit dada, pengsan, sesak nafas teruk atau tanda strok.

title: Heart rate
en: A normal resting heart rate for adults is about 60 to 100 beats per minute. It goes up with activity, fever, stress, caffeine or dehydration. Some heart medicines lower it on purpose. See a doctor if your resting rate stays above 120 or below 45, or if it feels very irregular, especially with dizziness, chest pain or breathlessness.
ms: Kadar jantung rehat normal orang dewasa ialah kira-kira 60 hingga 100 denyutan seminit. Ia naik ketika aktiviti, demam, tekanan, kafein atau dehidrasi. Sesetengah ubat jantung sengaja merendahkannya. Jumpa doktor jika kadar rehat kekal melebihi 120 atau bawah 45, atau terasa sangat tidak teratur, terutamanya dengan pening atau sakit dada.

title: High cholesterol
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Dyslipidaemia
en: Cholesterol is a fat in the blood. Too much 'bad' LDL cholesterol can clog arteries and raise the risk of heart attack and stroke. Eating less fried and fatty food, choosing more vegetables, fruit and whole grains, staying active, not smoking and taking any prescribed statin all help.
ms: Kolesterol ialah lemak dalam darah. Terlalu banyak kolesterol LDL 'jahat' boleh menyumbat arteri dan meningkatkan risiko serangan jantung dan strok. Kurangkan makanan bergoreng dan berlemak, lebihkan sayur, buah dan bijirin penuh, aktif bergerak, jangan merokok dan ambil statin jika dipreskripsi.

title: Blood oxygen (SpO2)
en: SpO2 is the percentage of oxygen in your blood, measured with a finger clip. For most healthy people it is 95 to 100 percent. Readings that stay below 92 percent, or any drop together with breathlessness, need medical attention. Some lung conditions have a lower personal target set by the doctor. Cold fingers, nail polish or movement can give falsely low readings, so warm your hands, sit still and check again.
ms: SpO2 ialah peratusan oksigen dalam darah, diukur dengan klip jari. Bagi kebanyakan orang sihat ia 95 hingga 100 peratus. Bacaan yang kekal bawah 92 peratus, atau penurunan bersama sesak nafas, perlu rawatan. Sesetengah penyakit paru-paru mempunyai sasaran lebih rendah yang ditetapkan doktor. Jari sejuk, pengilat kuku atau pergerakan boleh memberi bacaan rendah palsu, jadi panaskan tangan, duduk diam dan periksa semula.

title: Metformin
en: Metformin lowers blood sugar in type 2 diabetes. Take it with or just after meals to reduce stomach upset; nausea or loose stools are common at first and usually settle. On its own it rarely causes low sugar. Tell your doctor before surgery or scans that use contrast dye, if you have kidney problems, or if you are vomiting and can't keep fluids down.
ms: Metformin merendahkan gula darah bagi diabetes jenis 2. Ambil bersama atau selepas makan untuk mengurangkan sakit perut; loya atau najis lembik biasa pada awalnya dan biasanya hilang. Secara sendirian ia jarang menyebabkan gula rendah. Beritahu doktor sebelum pembedahan atau imbasan dengan pewarna, jika ada masalah buah pinggang, atau jika muntah dan tidak dapat minum.

title: Gliclazide (and other sulfonylureas)
en: Gliclazide helps the pancreas release more insulin to lower blood sugar. Unlike metformin, it can cause low blood sugar, especially if you skip or delay meals, are more active than usual, or drink alcohol. Take it with a meal, usually breakfast, as prescribed. Learn the signs of a hypo and keep some fast sugar with you.
ms: Gliclazide membantu pankreas mengeluarkan lebih insulin untuk merendahkan gula darah. Tidak seperti metformin, ia boleh menyebabkan gula rendah, terutamanya jika anda tidak makan atau lambat makan, lebih aktif daripada biasa, atau minum alkohol. Ambil bersama makanan, biasanya sarapan, seperti dipreskripsi. Kenali tanda gula rendah dan bawa sedikit gula cepat.

title: Amlodipine
en: Amlodipine relaxes blood vessels to lower blood pressure. Take it at the same time each day. Common side effects include ankle swelling, flushing, headache or dizziness, especially when you first start. Don't stop it suddenly without talking to your doctor, and stand up slowly if you feel light-headed.
ms: Amlodipine melegakan salur darah untuk merendahkan tekanan darah. Ambil pada masa yang sama setiap hari. Kesan sampingan biasa termasuk buku lali bengkak, muka merah, sakit kepala atau pening, terutamanya pada awal. Jangan berhenti tiba-tiba tanpa berbincang dengan doktor, dan bangun perlahan-lahan jika rasa pening.

title: Perindopril, enalapril and other ACE inhibitors
source: NHS: Ramipril / ACE inhibitors; product information
en: ACE inhibitors such as perindopril and enalapril lower blood pressure and protect the heart and kidneys. A dry, tickly cough is a common side effect; tell your doctor, as there are alternatives. Dizziness can happen at first. Your doctor may check kidney function and potassium with blood tests. Get emergency help for swelling of the lips, face or tongue.
ms: Perencat ACE seperti perindopril dan enalapril merendahkan tekanan darah serta melindungi jantung dan buah pinggang. Batuk kering ialah kesan sampingan biasa; beritahu doktor kerana ada pilihan lain. Pening boleh berlaku pada awalnya. Doktor mungkin memeriksa fungsi buah pinggang dan kalium. Dapatkan bantuan kecemasan jika bibir, muka atau lidah bengkak.

title: Losartan, telmisartan and other ARBs
en: ARBs such as losartan and telmisartan lower blood pressure and protect the kidneys, especially with diabetes. They work like ACE inhibitors but rarely cause a cough. Dizziness can happen at first. Your doctor may check kidney function and potassium with blood tests. Take it at the same time each day and don't stop it without advice.
ms: ARB seperti losartan dan telmisartan merendahkan tekanan darah dan melindungi buah pinggang, terutamanya bagi pesakit diabetes. Ia berfungsi seperti perencat ACE tetapi jarang menyebabkan batuk. Pening boleh berlaku pada awalnya. Doktor mungkin memeriksa fungsi buah pinggang dan kalium. Ambil pada masa yang sama setiap hari dan jangan berhenti tanpa nasihat.

title: Atorvastatin, simvastatin (statins)
en: Statins lower cholesterol and reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke. Take your statin at the same time each day. Tell your doctor about unexplained muscle pain, weakness or dark urine. Some statins interact with large amounts of grapefruit juice, so check your leaflet.
ms: Statin merendahkan kolesterol dan mengurangkan risiko serangan jantung dan strok. Ambil pada masa yang sama setiap hari. Beritahu doktor jika ada sakit otot tanpa sebab, lemah atau air kencing gelap. Sesetengah statin berinteraksi dengan jus limau gedang dalam jumlah besar, jadi semak risalah anda.

title: Low-dose aspirin
en: Low-dose aspirin is prescribed for some people to lower the risk of heart attack or stroke. Take it with or after food. Tell your doctor about black stools, vomiting blood, or unusual bruising or bleeding. Don't start or stop it on your own, and check with a pharmacist before taking painkillers like ibuprofen.
ms: Aspirin dos rendah dipreskripsi untuk sesetengah orang bagi mengurangkan risiko serangan jantung atau strok. Ambil bersama atau selepas makan. Beritahu doktor jika najis hitam, muntah darah, atau lebam atau pendarahan luar biasa. Jangan mula atau berhenti sendiri, dan tanya ahli farmasi sebelum mengambil ubat tahan sakit seperti ibuprofen.

title: Warfarin and other blood thinners
en: Blood thinners lower the risk of clots and stroke, but increase the risk of bleeding. With warfarin, you need regular INR blood tests. Keep the amount of green leafy vegetables in your diet steady rather than suddenly changing it, and check with a pharmacist before any new medicine, supplement or herbal remedy. Get urgent help for black stools, blood in urine, vomiting blood, a severe headache or a bad fall.
ms: Ubat cair darah mengurangkan risiko darah beku dan strok, tetapi meningkatkan risiko pendarahan. Dengan warfarin, anda perlu ujian darah INR secara berkala. Kekalkan jumlah sayur berdaun hijau dalam diet dan jangan ubah mendadak. Tanya ahli farmasi sebelum ubat, suplemen atau ubat herba baharu. Dapatkan bantuan segera jika najis hitam, darah dalam air kencing, muntah darah, sakit kepala teruk atau jatuh teruk.

title: Paracetamol (e.g. Panadol)
source: NHS: Paracetamol for adults; product label
en: Paracetamol helps with pain and fever. Follow the dose on the label or from your pharmacist, and never take more than the maximum stated for 24 hours. Some people, such as those with liver problems or very low body weight, need less. Many cold and flu products also contain paracetamol, so check labels before combining them.
ms: Paracetamol membantu melegakan sakit dan demam. Ikut dos pada label atau daripada ahli farmasi, dan jangan melebihi had maksimum dalam 24 jam. Sesetengah orang, seperti yang mempunyai masalah hati atau berat badan sangat rendah, perlu kurang. Banyak ubat selesema juga mengandungi paracetamol, jadi semak label sebelum menggabungkan.

title: Ibuprofen and other NSAID painkillers
en: NSAID painkillers such as ibuprofen and diclofenac can irritate the stomach and, in some people, affect the kidneys, blood pressure and heart. Ask a pharmacist or doctor before using them if you are older, have kidney, heart or stomach problems, high blood pressure, or take blood thinners. Avoid them if dengue is possible.
ms: Ubat tahan sakit NSAID seperti ibuprofen dan diclofenac boleh merengsakan perut dan, bagi sesetengah orang, menjejaskan buah pinggang, tekanan darah dan jantung. Tanya ahli farmasi atau doktor sebelum menggunakannya jika anda warga emas, ada masalah buah pinggang, jantung atau perut, darah tinggi, atau mengambil ubat cair darah. Elakkan jika mungkin denggi.

title: Omeprazole and other stomach-acid medicines
en: Omeprazole lowers stomach acid. It is used for heartburn, reflux, ulcers and sometimes to protect the stomach from other medicines. It usually works best taken before a meal, often in the morning; follow your prescription. If you've taken it for a long time, ask your doctor at your next review whether you still need it. See a doctor for difficulty swallowing, weight loss or black stools.
ms: Omeprazole mengurangkan asid perut. Ia digunakan untuk pedih ulu hati, refluks, ulser dan kadang-kadang melindungi perut daripada ubat lain. Biasanya paling berkesan diambil sebelum makan, selalunya pagi; ikut preskripsi anda. Jika sudah lama mengambilnya, tanya doktor semasa semakan sama ada masih perlu. Jumpa doktor jika sukar menelan, berat badan turun atau najis hitam.

title: Taking antibiotics
en: Take antibiotics exactly as prescribed, for as long as your doctor says, even if you feel better. Never save leftovers for later or share them. Antibiotics don't work on colds or flu, which are caused by viruses. Tell your doctor about any allergy, and get emergency help for a rash with swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.
ms: Ambil antibiotik tepat seperti dipreskripsi, mengikut tempoh yang ditetapkan doktor, walaupun sudah rasa sihat. Jangan simpan baki untuk kemudian atau berkongsi. Antibiotik tidak berkesan untuk selesema yang disebabkan virus. Beritahu doktor tentang alahan, dan dapatkan bantuan kecemasan jika ruam bersama muka bengkak atau sukar bernafas.

title: Prednisolone (steroid tablets)
en: Prednisolone reduces inflammation. Take it in the morning with food, as prescribed. If you've taken it for more than a few weeks, don't stop suddenly; your doctor will reduce it gradually. It can raise blood sugar, which matters if you have diabetes, and it can affect sleep, mood and appetite. Tell any doctor treating you that you take steroids.
ms: Prednisolone mengurangkan keradangan. Ambil pada waktu pagi bersama makanan, seperti dipreskripsi. Jika sudah mengambilnya lebih beberapa minggu, jangan berhenti tiba-tiba; doktor akan mengurangkannya secara beransur. Ia boleh menaikkan gula darah, yang penting jika anda ada diabetes, dan boleh menjejaskan tidur, emosi dan selera.

title: If you miss a dose
en: For many tablets, the leaflet says to take the missed dose when you remember, unless it's almost time for the next one, in which case you skip it. Never take a double dose to make up. Some medicines, such as insulin, blood thinners and seizure medicines, have different rules, so check the leaflet or ask your pharmacist for your specific medicine.
ms: Bagi banyak tablet, risalah menyatakan ambil dos yang tertinggal sebaik teringat, kecuali hampir tiba masa dos seterusnya, maka langkau sahaja. Jangan ambil dos berganda. Sesetengah ubat, seperti insulin, ubat cair darah dan ubat sawan, ada peraturan berbeza, jadi semak risalah atau tanya ahli farmasi.

title: Managing many medicines safely
source: WHO: Medication Without Harm; MOH Malaysia Pharmacy Services
en: Keep an up-to-date list of all your medicines, including supplements and herbal products, and bring it to every appointment. A weekly pill organiser helps. Store medicines in a cool, dry place away from children. Don't use expired medicines; return them to a pharmacy. Ask your pharmacist to review your medicines once a year, or after any hospital stay.
ms: Simpan senarai terkini semua ubat anda, termasuk suplemen dan produk herba, dan bawa setiap kali temujanji. Kotak ubat mingguan membantu. Simpan ubat di tempat sejuk dan kering, jauh dari kanak-kanak. Jangan guna ubat tamat tempoh; pulangkan ke farmasi. Minta ahli farmasi menyemak ubat anda setahun sekali atau selepas keluar hospital.

title: Preventing falls at home
source: WHO Falls fact sheet; WHO Step Safely (2023)
en: To lower your risk of falling, keep floors dry and clear, use non-slip mats in the bathroom, and add grab bars near the toilet and shower. Keep a light on at night and wear well-fitting shoes. Stand up slowly and do gentle balance and strength exercises. Ask your doctor to review medicines that make you drowsy or dizzy, and have your eyes checked regularly.
ms: Untuk mengurangkan risiko jatuh, pastikan lantai kering dan bebas sepah, guna tikar anti-gelincir di bilik air, dan pasang palang pemegang dekat tandas. Biarkan lampu menyala pada waktu malam dan pakai kasut yang sesuai. Bangun perlahan-lahan dan lakukan senaman imbangan ringan. Minta doktor menyemak ubat yang menyebabkan mengantuk atau pening, dan periksa mata secara berkala.

title: What to do after a fall
en: After a fall, stay calm and check for pain before moving. If you're hurt, feel dizzy or can't get up, stay still, keep warm and call for help; I can alert your caregiver. If you feel able, roll onto your side, get onto your hands and knees, crawl to a sturdy chair and slowly push yourself up. Always tell your doctor about a fall, even if you feel fine.
ms: Selepas jatuh, bertenang dan periksa jika ada sakit sebelum bergerak. Jika cedera, pening atau tak boleh bangun, kekal di tempat, panaskan badan dan minta bantuan; saya boleh maklumkan penjaga anda. Jika mampu, berguling ke sisi, merangkak ke kerusi yang kukuh dan bangun perlahan-lahan. Beritahu doktor tentang setiap kejadian jatuh.

title: Osteoporosis (weak bones)
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Osteoporosis; NHS
en: Osteoporosis makes bones thinner and more likely to break, often with no warning until a fracture. Help your bones with enough calcium from milk, tofu, ikan bilis eaten with the bones, and green vegetables. Get vitamin D from some sunlight and food, do regular weight-bearing exercise such as walking, don't smoke, and take steps to prevent falls. Your doctor can advise on tests and treatment.
ms: Osteoporosis menjadikan tulang lebih nipis dan mudah patah, selalunya tanpa amaran sehingga patah. Bantu tulang dengan kalsium yang cukup daripada susu, tauhu, ikan bilis dimakan bersama tulang dan sayur hijau. Dapatkan vitamin D daripada cahaya matahari dan makanan, bersenam seperti berjalan, jangan merokok dan cegah jatuh. Doktor boleh menasihati tentang ujian dan rawatan.

title: Knee and joint pain (osteoarthritis)
en: Osteoarthritis causes stiff, painful joints, often the knees and hips. Gentle regular exercise such as walking, swimming or physiotherapy exercises actually helps, as does keeping a healthy weight. Heat or cold packs can ease pain. Ask a pharmacist before using painkillers regularly. See a doctor if a joint becomes hot, red and very swollen.
ms: Osteoartritis menyebabkan sendi kaku dan sakit, selalunya lutut dan pinggul. Senaman ringan yang kerap seperti berjalan, berenang atau senaman fisioterapi sebenarnya membantu, begitu juga menjaga berat badan. Tuaman panas atau sejuk boleh melegakan. Tanya ahli farmasi sebelum kerap menggunakan ubat tahan sakit. Jumpa doktor jika sendi menjadi panas, merah dan sangat bengkak.

title: Gout
en: Gout is sudden, very painful swelling of a joint, often the big toe, caused by uric acid crystals. During an attack, rest and raise the joint, apply an ice pack wrapped in a cloth, and see a doctor about treatment. To help prevent attacks, drink plenty of water, limit alcohol, especially beer, sugary drinks, organ meats and large amounts of red meat and some seafood, and take any long-term medicine as prescribed.
ms: Gout ialah bengkak sendi yang tiba-tiba dan sangat sakit, selalunya ibu jari kaki, akibat kristal asid urik. Semasa serangan, rehatkan dan angkat sendi, tuam dengan ais berbalut kain, dan jumpa doktor untuk rawatan. Untuk mencegah, minum banyak air, hadkan alkohol, minuman bergula, organ dalaman dan daging merah serta sesetengah makanan laut dalam jumlah besar, dan ambil ubat jangka panjang seperti dipreskripsi.

title: Back pain
en: Most back pain gets better within a few weeks. Keep gently moving rather than staying in bed, use heat packs, and ask a pharmacist about suitable pain relief. Get urgent help for back pain with numbness around the bottom or genitals, new problems controlling your bladder or bowel, weakness in the legs, or after a fall or injury, especially if you have osteoporosis.
ms: Kebanyakan sakit belakang pulih dalam beberapa minggu. Teruskan bergerak perlahan-lahan dan jangan hanya berbaring, guna tuaman panas, dan tanya ahli farmasi tentang ubat tahan sakit yang sesuai. Dapatkan bantuan segera jika sakit belakang disertai kebas di punggung atau kemaluan, masalah baharu mengawal kencing atau najis, kaki lemah, atau selepas jatuh.

title: Headache: when to worry
en: Most headaches are caused by tension, lack of sleep, dehydration or missed meals, and ease with rest, water and simple pain relief. Call 999 for a sudden, severe 'worst ever' headache, a headache with weakness, confusion, slurred speech or a stiff neck with fever, or a headache after a head injury. See a doctor if headaches are new and keep coming back, especially over age 50.
ms: Kebanyakan sakit kepala disebabkan ketegangan, kurang tidur, kekurangan air atau tidak makan, dan lega dengan rehat, air dan ubat tahan sakit ringan. Hubungi 999 jika sakit kepala tiba-tiba dan paling teruk pernah dialami, sakit kepala dengan lemah, keliru, pelat atau leher kaku bersama demam, atau selepas kecederaan kepala.

title: Dehydration
source: NHS: Dehydration; MOH Malaysia heat-related illness advice
en: In Malaysia's heat it's easy to become dehydrated, especially for older adults, who may feel less thirsty. Signs include dark urine, a dry mouth, dizziness and tiredness. Sip water throughout the day; around 6 to 8 glasses suits most people. Follow your doctor's limit instead if you've been told to restrict fluids, for example with heart failure or kidney disease.
ms: Dalam cuaca panas Malaysia mudah berlaku dehidrasi, terutamanya warga emas yang kurang rasa dahaga. Tandanya air kencing gelap, mulut kering, pening dan letih. Minum air sedikit demi sedikit sepanjang hari; sekitar 6 hingga 8 gelas sesuai untuk kebanyakan orang. Ikut had doktor jika anda dinasihatkan menghadkan cecair, contohnya kegagalan jantung atau penyakit buah pinggang.

title: Heat exhaustion and heatstroke
source: WHO: Heat and health; MOH Malaysia heat-related illness advice
en: Heat exhaustion causes heavy sweating, tiredness, dizziness, headache and nausea. Move to a cool place, drink water, loosen clothing and cool the skin with water and a fan. Heatstroke is an emergency: confusion, hot dry skin, a very high temperature, fainting or seizures mean you should call 999 and start cooling the person while you wait. Stay indoors at the hottest time of day and drink regularly.
ms: Kelesuan haba menyebabkan banyak berpeluh, letih, pening, sakit kepala dan loya. Pindah ke tempat sejuk, minum air, longgarkan pakaian dan sejukkan kulit dengan air dan kipas. Strok haba ialah kecemasan: keliru, kulit panas dan kering, suhu sangat tinggi, pengsan atau sawan bermaksud hubungi 999 dan mula menyejukkan pesakit sementara menunggu.

title: Dengue fever
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Dengue Infection in Adults (3rd ed., 2015); WHO Dengue fact sheet
en: Dengue causes high fever, headache, pain behind the eyes, body aches and sometimes a rash. Danger often comes around the time the fever settles, roughly days 3 to 7. Seek help urgently for severe stomach pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding gums or nose, black stools, drowsiness or restlessness. Use paracetamol for fever; avoid ibuprofen and aspirin unless a doctor says otherwise. Drink plenty of fluids and see a clinic early.
ms: Denggi menyebabkan demam tinggi, sakit kepala, sakit belakang mata, sakit badan dan kadang-kadang ruam. Bahaya selalunya apabila demam mula turun, sekitar hari 3 hingga 7. Dapatkan bantuan segera jika sakit perut teruk, muntah berterusan, gusi atau hidung berdarah, najis hitam, mengantuk atau gelisah. Guna paracetamol untuk demam; elakkan ibuprofen dan aspirin. Minum banyak air dan jumpa klinik awal.

title: Fever
en: A temperature of 38°C or higher is a fever. Rest, drink fluids and use paracetamol as the label directs. See a doctor if it lasts more than 2 to 3 days or goes above 39.5°C. Also see one if it comes with a stiff neck, a rash that doesn't fade when pressed, breathing difficulty or confusion, or if you have diabetes, kidney disease or a weak immune system. In Malaysia, consider dengue when fever is high with body aches.
ms: Suhu 38°C atau lebih ialah demam. Berehat, minum air dan guna paracetamol mengikut label. Jumpa doktor jika berlarutan lebih 2 hingga 3 hari atau melebihi 39.5°C. Jumpa juga jika disertai leher kaku, ruam yang tidak pudar bila ditekan, sesak nafas atau keliru, atau jika anda ada diabetes, penyakit buah pinggang atau imuniti lemah. Di Malaysia, pertimbangkan denggi jika demam tinggi dengan sakit badan.

title: Flu, COVID-19 and colds
source: WHO: Influenza and COVID-19 fact sheets; MOH Malaysia
en: Most colds, flu and COVID-19 infections get better with rest, fluids and paracetamol for fever or aches. Wear a mask around others and wash your hands. Older adults and people with diabetes, heart or lung disease are at higher risk, so contact a clinic early, as some treatments work best in the first few days. Get urgent help for breathlessness, chest pain, confusion, bluish lips, or oxygen readings staying below 92 percent.
ms: Kebanyakan selesema, influenza dan COVID-19 pulih dengan rehat, air dan paracetamol untuk demam atau sakit badan. Pakai pelitup muka dan basuh tangan. Warga emas dan pesakit diabetes, jantung atau paru-paru lebih berisiko, jadi hubungi klinik awal kerana sesetengah rawatan paling berkesan dalam beberapa hari pertama. Dapatkan bantuan segera jika sesak nafas, sakit dada, keliru, bibir kebiruan atau oksigen kekal bawah 92 peratus.

title: Chest infection and pneumonia
en: Pneumonia is a lung infection. It causes cough with phlegm, fever, breathlessness and chest pain on breathing. In older adults it may show mainly as confusion, weakness or falls. See a doctor promptly. Call 999 for severe breathlessness, blue lips, new confusion or oxygen readings staying below 92 percent.
ms: Radang paru-paru ialah jangkitan paru-paru. Ia menyebabkan batuk berkahak, demam, sesak nafas dan sakit dada ketika bernafas. Pada warga emas ia mungkin hanya menunjukkan keliru, lemah atau jatuh. Jumpa doktor segera. Hubungi 999 jika sesak nafas teruk, bibir biru, keliru baharu atau oksigen kekal bawah 92 peratus.

title: Vaccines for older adults
source: WHO immunization position papers; MOH Malaysia adult immunisation guidance
en: Vaccines lower the risk of serious illness. Older adults and people with long-term conditions are commonly advised to have a yearly flu vaccine and a pneumococcal vaccine, and to keep COVID-19 vaccination up to date as recommended. Ask your doctor or Klinik Kesihatan which vaccines suit you.
ms: Vaksin mengurangkan risiko penyakit serius. Warga emas dan pesakit penyakit kronik biasanya dinasihatkan mengambil vaksin influenza setiap tahun dan vaksin pneumokokal, serta mengemas kini vaksin COVID-19 seperti disyorkan. Tanya doktor atau Klinik Kesihatan vaksin mana yang sesuai untuk anda.

title: Diarrhoea and vomiting
source: WHO: Oral rehydration salts; NHS: Diarrhoea and vomiting
en: The main risk is losing too much fluid. Take small, frequent sips of oral rehydration salts, made exactly as the packet says, or water. Eat light food when you can. See a doctor if it lasts more than 2 days, if there's blood in your stool, if you can't keep fluids down, or if you feel dizzy or are passing very little urine. If you take metformin or blood pressure medicines, ask a doctor or pharmacist whether to pause them while unwell.
ms: Risiko utama ialah kehilangan cecair. Minum sedikit-sedikit tetapi kerap larutan garam hidrasi oral, dibancuh tepat seperti arahan paket, atau air. Makan makanan ringan bila boleh. Jumpa doktor jika berlarutan lebih 2 hari, ada darah dalam najis, tidak dapat minum, pening atau sangat kurang kencing. Jika mengambil metformin atau ubat darah tinggi, tanya doktor atau ahli farmasi sama ada perlu berhenti sementara.

title: Constipation
en: Constipation is common with age, inactivity and some medicines. Drink enough water, and eat more fibre from vegetables, fruit such as papaya and dragon fruit, oats and wholegrains. Move around daily, and don't ignore the urge to go. A pharmacist can suggest a suitable laxative. See a doctor for blood in your stool, unexplained weight loss, severe stomach pain, or a lasting change in bowel habit.
ms: Sembelit biasa berlaku dengan usia, kurang bergerak dan sesetengah ubat. Minum air yang cukup, dan makan lebih serat daripada sayur, buah seperti betik dan buah naga, oat dan bijirin penuh. Bergerak setiap hari dan jangan tahan bila rasa nak buang air. Ahli farmasi boleh mencadangkan julap yang sesuai. Jumpa doktor jika ada darah dalam najis, berat badan turun tanpa sebab atau sakit perut teruk.

title: Urinary tract infection (UTI)
en: A UTI can cause burning when passing urine, needing to go often, cloudy or smelly urine, and lower tummy pain. In older adults it may instead cause sudden confusion or falls. Drink fluids and see a doctor, as antibiotics are often needed. Get help quickly for fever, back or side pain, shivering, or vomiting, which may mean a kidney infection.
ms: Jangkitan saluran kencing boleh menyebabkan pedih ketika kencing, kerap kencing, air kencing keruh atau berbau, dan sakit perut bawah. Pada warga emas ia mungkin menyebabkan keliru tiba-tiba atau jatuh. Minum air dan jumpa doktor, kerana antibiotik selalunya diperlukan. Dapatkan bantuan segera jika demam, sakit belakang atau sisi, menggigil atau muntah.

title: Kidney health
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Chronic Kidney Disease (2nd ed., 2018)
en: Diabetes and high blood pressure are the leading causes of kidney disease in Malaysia. You can protect your kidneys by controlling sugar and blood pressure, limiting salt, and not smoking. Avoid regular use of painkillers like ibuprofen, or herbal remedies, without advice. Your doctor checks kidney function with blood tests (eGFR) and urine tests.
ms: Diabetes dan darah tinggi ialah punca utama penyakit buah pinggang di Malaysia. Lindungi buah pinggang dengan mengawal gula dan tekanan darah, kurangkan garam dan jangan merokok. Elakkan menggunakan ubat tahan sakit seperti ibuprofen atau ubat herba secara kerap tanpa nasihat. Doktor memeriksa fungsi buah pinggang dengan ujian darah (eGFR) dan air kencing.

title: Using an inhaler (asthma and COPD)
source: Global Initiative for Asthma (GINA); NHS: How to use an inhaler
en: For a standard puffer, shake it and breathe out fully. Seal your lips around the mouthpiece, press once as you start a slow deep breath in, then hold your breath for about 10 seconds. A spacer helps a lot. Rinse your mouth after steroid inhalers. Ask your nurse or pharmacist to check your technique. If your reliever isn't helping, or you're too breathless to speak, call 999.
ms: Untuk inhaler biasa, goncang dan hembus nafas sepenuhnya. Kemam bibir pada corong, tekan sekali sambil mula menarik nafas perlahan dan dalam, kemudian tahan nafas kira-kira 10 saat. Spacer sangat membantu. Berkumur selepas inhaler steroid. Minta jururawat atau ahli farmasi menyemak teknik anda. Jika inhaler pelega tidak membantu atau terlalu sesak untuk bercakap, hubungi 999.

title: Healthy eating (Malaysian Healthy Plate)
source: MOH Malaysia: Malaysian Dietary Guidelines / Pinggan Sihat Malaysia (suku-suku separuh)
en: The Malaysian Healthy Plate, 'suku-suku separuh', is a simple guide. Fill half the plate with vegetables and fruit, a quarter with protein such as fish, chicken, eggs, tofu or beans, and a quarter with rice or other carbohydrates, preferably wholegrain. Go easy on sugar in drinks like teh tarik, and on santan, fried foods and salty sauces. Drink plain water.
ms: Pinggan Sihat Malaysia, 'suku-suku separuh', ialah panduan mudah. Isi separuh pinggan dengan sayur dan buah, suku dengan protein seperti ikan, ayam, telur, tauhu atau kekacang, dan suku dengan nasi atau karbohidrat lain, lebih baik bijirin penuh. Kurangkan gula dalam minuman seperti teh tarik, dan santan, makanan bergoreng serta sos masin. Minum air kosong.

title: Poor appetite and weight loss in older adults
source: WHO: Integrated care for older people (ICOPE)
en: Poor appetite and unplanned weight loss are common, and important to act on in older adults. Try smaller, more frequent meals and snacks with protein, such as eggs, fish, milk, tofu or beans, and eat with others when possible. Tell your doctor about unplanned weight loss, difficulty chewing or swallowing, or low mood, as these can often be helped.
ms: Kurang selera makan dan berat badan turun tanpa sebab adalah biasa dan penting untuk ditangani pada warga emas. Cuba hidangan lebih kecil tetapi kerap dengan protein seperti telur, ikan, susu, tauhu atau kekacang, dan makan bersama orang lain jika boleh. Beritahu doktor jika berat badan turun tanpa sebab, sukar mengunyah atau menelan, atau emosi rendah.

title: Staying active
source: WHO Guidelines on Physical Activity and Sedentary Behaviour (2020)
en: WHO recommends that adults aim for at least 150 minutes of moderate activity a week, for example a 30-minute walk on 5 days. Add muscle-strengthening on 2 or more days, and balance exercises for older adults. If you're recovering or have heart, lung or joint problems, start small, even 5 to 10 minutes, and ask your doctor or physiotherapist what's safe. Stop if you get chest pain, severe breathlessness or dizziness.
ms: WHO mengesyorkan orang dewasa menyasarkan sekurang-kurangnya 150 minit aktiviti sederhana seminggu, contohnya berjalan 30 minit selama 5 hari. Tambah senaman menguatkan otot 2 hari atau lebih, dan senaman imbangan untuk warga emas. Jika dalam pemulihan atau ada masalah jantung, paru-paru atau sendi, mulakan sedikit, 5 hingga 10 minit, dan tanya doktor apa yang selamat.

title: Sleep
en: Helpful sleep habits include regular sleep and wake times, avoiding caffeine after mid-afternoon, keeping the room cool and dark, putting screens away an hour before bed, and avoiding heavy late meals. Tell your doctor about loud snoring with pauses in breathing, or poor sleep that lasts for weeks. Some medicines and conditions also affect sleep.
ms: Tabiat tidur yang baik termasuk waktu tidur dan bangun yang tetap, elak kafein selepas petang, bilik sejuk dan gelap, jauhkan skrin sejam sebelum tidur, dan elak makan berat lewat malam. Beritahu doktor jika berdengkur kuat dengan henti nafas, atau susah tidur berminggu-minggu.

title: Quitting smoking
source: MOH Malaysia: mQuit services; WHO Tobacco fact sheet
en: Stopping smoking at any age lowers the risk of heart attack, stroke, lung disease and cancer, and helps wounds heal. Support and medicines greatly improve your chances. Malaysia's Ministry of Health runs quit-smoking services through its mQuit programme. Ask at your Klinik Kesihatan or a participating pharmacy.
ms: Berhenti merokok pada usia berapa pun mengurangkan risiko serangan jantung, strok, penyakit paru-paru dan kanser, serta membantu luka sembuh. Sokongan dan ubat sangat meningkatkan peluang berjaya. KKM menyediakan perkhidmatan berhenti merokok melalui program mQuit. Tanya di Klinik Kesihatan atau farmasi yang menyertai.

title: Stress, loneliness and low mood
source: WHO Depression fact sheet; MOH Malaysia Talian HEAL 15555
en: Feeling low, stressed or lonely is common, especially when you're unwell or live alone, and it's okay to ask for support. Small steps help: a daily routine, short walks, talking to someone you trust, and things you enjoy. If low mood lasts more than two weeks, talk to your doctor. You can call Talian HEAL 15555, or Befrienders KL on 03-7627 2929. If you think about harming yourself, call 999.
ms: Rasa sedih, tertekan atau sunyi adalah biasa, terutamanya ketika sakit atau tinggal seorang diri, dan tidak salah meminta sokongan. Langkah kecil membantu: rutin harian, berjalan sebentar, berbual dengan orang yang dipercayai. Jika berlarutan lebih dua minggu, berjumpa doktor. Anda boleh hubungi Talian HEAL 15555 atau Befrienders KL 03-7627 2929. Jika terfikir untuk mencederakan diri, hubungi 999.

title: Memory problems and dementia
source: WHO Dementia fact sheet; Alzheimer's Disease Foundation Malaysia (ADFM)
en: Some forgetfulness is normal with age. See a doctor if memory problems get worse or affect daily life, such as getting lost in familiar places, repeating questions, trouble managing money or medicines, or personality changes. Some causes, like thyroid problems, vitamin B12 deficiency, depression or medicine side effects, are treatable. Sudden confusion over hours or days is different and needs urgent care.
ms: Sedikit pelupa adalah biasa dengan usia. Jumpa doktor jika masalah ingatan bertambah teruk atau menjejaskan kehidupan harian, seperti sesat di tempat biasa, mengulang soalan, sukar menguruskan wang atau ubat, atau perubahan personaliti. Sesetengah punca, seperti masalah tiroid, kekurangan vitamin B12, kemurungan atau kesan ubat, boleh dirawat. Keliru tiba-tiba dalam beberapa jam atau hari perlu rawatan segera.

title: Sudden confusion (delirium)
en: Sudden confusion that develops over hours or days is called delirium, and it is a medical warning sign, especially in older adults. Common causes include infections such as UTI or pneumonia, dehydration, low or high blood sugar, new medicines, or pain. Get medical help the same day. Call 999 if it comes with stroke signs, breathing difficulty, very high fever or drowsiness.
ms: Keliru tiba-tiba yang berlaku dalam beberapa jam atau hari dipanggil delirium dan merupakan tanda amaran, terutamanya pada warga emas. Punca biasa termasuk jangkitan seperti jangkitan saluran kencing atau radang paru-paru, dehidrasi, gula darah rendah atau tinggi, ubat baharu atau kesakitan. Dapatkan rawatan pada hari yang sama. Hubungi 999 jika disertai tanda strok, sesak nafas atau sangat mengantuk.

title: Recovering at home after hospital
en: Recovery at home goes best when you take medicines exactly as prescribed, do gentle activity as advised, eat and drink well, rest, and keep follow-up appointments. Watch for the warning signs your team gave you, such as fever, increasing pain, a red or oozing wound, breathlessness or calf swelling, and contact them early. You can bring Kawan's report to your next visit.
ms: Pemulihan di rumah paling baik apabila anda makan ubat tepat seperti dipreskripsi, melakukan aktiviti ringan seperti dinasihatkan, makan dan minum dengan baik, berehat dan hadir temujanji susulan. Perhatikan tanda amaran yang diberi pasukan anda, seperti demam, sakit bertambah, luka merah atau bernanah, sesak nafas atau betis bengkak, dan hubungi mereka awal.

title: Caring for a wound or surgical cut
source: NHS: Caring for your wound after surgery
en: Keep the wound clean and dry, and follow the instructions for when you can shower and change the dressing. Wash your hands before touching it. See your doctor or clinic if it becomes more red, hot, swollen or painful, oozes pus, opens up, or if you develop a fever.
ms: Pastikan luka bersih dan kering, dan ikut arahan bila boleh mandi dan menukar balutan. Basuh tangan sebelum menyentuhnya. Jumpa doktor atau klinik jika luka menjadi lebih merah, panas, bengkak atau sakit, bernanah, terbuka, atau jika anda demam.

title: Preventing pressure sores (bedsores)
en: People who spend a long time in bed or a chair can develop pressure sores, often on the heels, hips and lower back. Change position regularly; the care team will advise how often, commonly every 2 hours in bed. Check the skin daily for redness that doesn't fade, keep the skin clean and dry, eat and drink well, and ask about pressure-relieving cushions or mattresses.
ms: Orang yang lama berbaring atau duduk boleh mendapat luka tekanan, selalunya di tumit, pinggul dan belakang bawah. Tukar kedudukan dengan kerap; pasukan penjagaan akan menasihati kekerapan, biasanya setiap 2 jam ketika di katil. Periksa kulit setiap hari untuk kemerahan yang tidak hilang, pastikan kulit bersih dan kering, makan dan minum dengan baik, dan tanya tentang kusyen atau tilam khas.

title: CPR when someone collapses
source: American Heart Association: Hands-Only CPR; Malaysian Society of Resuscitation guidance
en: If someone collapses and isn't breathing normally, call 999 and put the phone on speaker. Push hard and fast in the centre of the chest, about 5 to 6 centimetres deep and 100 to 120 times a minute, letting the chest come back up each time. Don't stop until help arrives or they start breathing. If an AED is nearby, turn it on and follow its voice instructions.
ms: Jika seseorang rebah dan tidak bernafas seperti biasa, hubungi 999 dan pasang pembesar suara telefon. Tekan kuat dan laju di tengah dada, kira-kira 5 hingga 6 sentimeter dalam, 100 hingga 120 kali seminit, biarkan dada naik semula setiap kali. Jangan berhenti sehingga bantuan tiba atau dia mula bernafas. Jika ada AED berdekatan, hidupkan dan ikut arahan suaranya.

title: Choking
source: Resuscitation Council UK; St John Ambulance
en: If an adult is choking and can't cough, speak or breathe, give up to 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand. If that doesn't work, give up to 5 abdominal thrusts: stand behind them and pull sharply inwards and upwards above the belly button. Keep alternating, and call 999 if it doesn't clear. Start CPR if they become unresponsive.
ms: Jika orang dewasa tercekik dan tidak boleh batuk, bercakap atau bernafas, beri sehingga 5 tepukan kuat di antara bilah bahu dengan tapak tangan. Jika tidak berkesan, beri sehingga 5 tekanan perut: berdiri di belakang dan tarik dengan kuat ke dalam dan ke atas di atas pusat. Ulang bergilir dan hubungi 999 jika tidak keluar. Mulakan CPR jika dia tidak sedar.

title: Burns first aid
en: Cool the burn under cool or lukewarm running water for 20 minutes as soon as possible. Don't use ice, butter, toothpaste or creams. Remove jewellery near the area, unless it's stuck, and cover the burn loosely with cling film or a clean plastic bag. Get medical help for large or deep burns, burns on the face, hands or genitals, or any burn in an older adult that you're unsure about.
ms: Sejukkan kesan melecur di bawah air mengalir yang sejuk atau suam selama 20 minit secepat mungkin. Jangan guna ais, mentega, ubat gigi atau krim. Tanggalkan barang kemas berdekatan, kecuali yang melekat, dan tutup longgar dengan pembalut plastik atau beg plastik bersih. Dapatkan rawatan untuk melecur besar atau dalam, di muka, tangan atau kemaluan.

title: Nosebleeds
en: Sit up and lean forward, not back. Pinch the soft part of your nose just above the nostrils for 10 to 15 minutes without letting go, and breathe through your mouth. Get urgent help if it lasts more than 20 to 30 minutes, if the bleeding is heavy, or if it follows a head injury. If you take blood thinners, tell your doctor about any nosebleeds.
ms: Duduk tegak dan condongkan badan ke hadapan, bukan ke belakang. Picit bahagian lembut hidung tepat di atas lubang hidung selama 10 hingga 15 minit tanpa melepaskan, dan bernafas melalui mulut. Dapatkan bantuan segera jika berlarutan lebih 20 hingga 30 minit, pendarahan banyak, atau selepas kecederaan kepala.

title: When to call 999
en: Call 999 for chest pain, severe breathlessness, stroke signs, collapse or unresponsiveness, a seizure that doesn't stop, heavy bleeding, a serious injury or fall, sudden severe confusion, or thoughts of self-harm. Say where you are clearly, stay on the line, and unlock the door if you can. I can also alert your caregiver with the Help button.
ms: Hubungi 999 untuk sakit dada, sesak nafas teruk, tanda strok, rebah atau tidak sedar, sawan yang tidak berhenti, pendarahan banyak, kecederaan atau jatuh yang serius, keliru teruk tiba-tiba, atau terfikir untuk mencederakan diri. Nyatakan lokasi dengan jelas, kekal dalam talian dan buka kunci pintu jika boleh. Saya juga boleh memaklumkan penjaga anda dengan butang Tolong.

title: Fasting in Ramadan with diabetes
source: IDF-DAR Diabetes and Ramadan Practical Guidelines; MOH Malaysia
en: If you have diabetes, talk to your doctor before Ramadan, ideally 6 to 8 weeks before, because some medicines and doses may need changing. Check your sugar more often while fasting; checking does not break the fast. Break your fast straight away if your sugar falls below 3.9 mmol/L, rises above 16.7 mmol/L, or you feel shaky, confused, faint or very unwell. Islam allows people who are ill to be exempt from fasting.
ms: Jika anda menghidap diabetes, berbincang dengan doktor sebelum Ramadan, sebaiknya 6 hingga 8 minggu lebih awal, kerana sesetengah ubat dan dos mungkin perlu diubah. Periksa gula lebih kerap semasa berpuasa; memeriksa gula tidak membatalkan puasa. Berbuka segera jika gula turun bawah 3.9 mmol/L, naik melebihi 16.7 mmol/L, atau anda rasa menggigil, keliru, nak pitam atau sangat tidak sihat. Islam memberi kelonggaran kepada orang sakit untuk tidak berpuasa.

title: Anaemia (low blood count)
source: NHS: Iron deficiency anaemia; WHO Anaemia fact sheet
en: Anaemia means your blood has fewer red cells or less haemoglobin than normal, so less oxygen reaches the body. It can cause tiredness, breathlessness, a pale face, a fast heartbeat or dizziness. A common cause is low iron, but there are others, so see a doctor for a blood test before taking iron tablets. Iron-rich foods include red meat, fish, eggs, beans and dark green vegetables.
ms: Anemia bermaksud darah anda mempunyai kurang sel darah merah atau hemoglobin daripada biasa, jadi kurang oksigen sampai ke badan. Ia boleh menyebabkan letih, sesak nafas, muka pucat, jantung berdebar atau pening. Punca biasa ialah kekurangan zat besi, tetapi ada punca lain, jadi jumpa doktor untuk ujian darah sebelum mengambil pil zat besi. Makanan kaya zat besi termasuk daging merah, ikan, telur, kekacang dan sayur hijau gelap.

title: Thyroid problems and levothyroxine
en: An underactive thyroid can cause tiredness, weight gain, feeling cold and constipation; an overactive one can cause weight loss, a fast heartbeat, shaking and feeling hot. Both are diagnosed with a blood test. If you take levothyroxine, take it at the same time each morning with water on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before breakfast or coffee, and keep it apart from calcium or iron tablets. Your doctor will check your levels with blood tests.
ms: Tiroid kurang aktif boleh menyebabkan letih, berat badan naik, rasa sejuk dan sembelit; tiroid terlampau aktif boleh menyebabkan berat badan turun, jantung berdebar, menggigil dan rasa panas. Kedua-duanya didiagnosis dengan ujian darah. Jika mengambil levothyroxine, ambil pada masa yang sama setiap pagi dengan air ketika perut kosong, sekurang-kurangnya 30 minit sebelum sarapan atau kopi, dan jauhkan daripada pil kalsium atau zat besi.

title: Tuberculosis (TB) and a long cough
source: MOH Malaysia TB control programme; WHO Tuberculosis fact sheet
en: A cough lasting more than 2 weeks should be checked by a doctor, especially with fever, night sweats, weight loss or blood in the phlegm, as these can be signs of tuberculosis. TB is common in Malaysia but curable with a full course of free treatment from government clinics. Cover your cough and go to your Klinik Kesihatan for a check-up.
ms: Batuk lebih 2 minggu perlu diperiksa doktor, terutamanya jika disertai demam, berpeluh malam, berat badan turun atau kahak berdarah, kerana ini boleh menjadi tanda tibi (TB). TB biasa di Malaysia tetapi boleh sembuh dengan rawatan penuh percuma di klinik kerajaan. Tutup mulut ketika batuk dan pergi ke Klinik Kesihatan untuk pemeriksaan.

title: Leptospirosis (rat urine disease)
en: Leptospirosis spreads through water or soil contaminated by animal urine, especially after floods or activities in rivers and waterfalls. It causes sudden fever, headache, muscle pain especially in the calves, and red eyes. See a doctor early and tell them about any flood or water exposure, as early antibiotics help. Wear boots and gloves when cleaning after a flood.
ms: Leptospirosis merebak melalui air atau tanah yang tercemar air kencing haiwan, terutamanya selepas banjir atau aktiviti di sungai dan air terjun. Ia menyebabkan demam mengejut, sakit kepala, sakit otot terutamanya di betis, dan mata merah. Jumpa doktor awal dan beritahu tentang pendedahan kepada banjir atau air, kerana antibiotik awal membantu. Pakai but dan sarung tangan ketika membersihkan selepas banjir.

title: Severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis)
en: Anaphylaxis is a life-threatening allergic reaction. Signs include swelling of the lips, tongue or throat, difficulty breathing or swallowing, wheezing, a widespread rash, and feeling faint. Call 999 immediately. If the person has an adrenaline auto-injector, use it. If they feel faint, lie them down with legs raised; if breathing is hard, let them sit up.
ms: Anafilaksis ialah tindak balas alahan yang boleh membawa maut. Tandanya termasuk bibir, lidah atau tekak bengkak, sukar bernafas atau menelan, berdehit, ruam merata, dan rasa nak pitam. Hubungi 999 segera. Jika pesakit ada pen suntikan adrenalin, gunakannya. Jika rasa nak pitam, baringkan dengan kaki diangkat; jika sukar bernafas, biarkan duduk.

title: Allergies and antihistamines
en: Mild allergies cause sneezing, an itchy runny nose, itchy eyes or a rash. Antihistamines such as cetirizine or loratadine can help; older ones such as chlorphenamine are more likely to cause drowsiness, which raises the risk of falls in older adults. Ask your pharmacist which suits you. Tell every doctor and pharmacist about any medicine allergy. Get emergency help for swelling of the face or difficulty breathing.
ms: Alahan ringan menyebabkan bersin, hidung berair dan gatal, mata gatal atau ruam. Antihistamin seperti cetirizine atau loratadine boleh membantu; jenis lama seperti chlorphenamine lebih cenderung menyebabkan mengantuk, yang meningkatkan risiko jatuh pada warga emas. Tanya ahli farmasi mana yang sesuai. Beritahu setiap doktor dan ahli farmasi tentang alahan ubat. Dapatkan bantuan kecemasan jika muka bengkak atau sukar bernafas.

title: Shingles (kayap)
en: Shingles is a painful rash of blisters, usually on one side of the body, caused by the chickenpox virus waking up again. It's more common in older adults. See a doctor or pharmacist as soon as possible, ideally within 3 days of the rash appearing, because antiviral medicine works best early. Get urgent help if the rash is near the eye. A vaccine can lower the risk; ask your doctor.
ms: Kayap ialah ruam berlepuh yang menyakitkan, biasanya pada sebelah badan, disebabkan virus cacar air yang aktif semula. Ia lebih biasa pada warga emas. Jumpa doktor atau ahli farmasi secepat mungkin, sebaiknya dalam 3 hari selepas ruam muncul, kerana ubat antivirus paling berkesan pada awalnya. Dapatkan bantuan segera jika ruam berhampiran mata. Vaksin boleh mengurangkan risiko; tanya doktor anda.

title: Cataract, glaucoma and eye checks
en: Cataracts make vision cloudy or blurry and are treated with a common, safe operation. Glaucoma often has no early symptoms but slowly damages side vision, which is why regular eye checks matter, especially over 40 or with diabetes or a family history. Go to an emergency department straight away for a sudden painful red eye with blurred vision or halos around lights, or sudden vision loss.
ms: Katarak menjadikan penglihatan kabur dan dirawat dengan pembedahan yang biasa dan selamat. Glaukoma selalunya tiada simptom awal tetapi perlahan-lahan merosakkan penglihatan sisi, sebab itu pemeriksaan mata berkala penting, terutamanya selepas umur 40 atau jika ada diabetes atau sejarah keluarga. Pergi ke jabatan kecemasan segera jika mata merah dan sakit secara tiba-tiba dengan penglihatan kabur, atau penglihatan hilang tiba-tiba.

title: Hearing loss
source: WHO: Deafness and hearing loss fact sheet
en: Hearing loss is common with age and can lead to loneliness and misunderstandings, including with medicine instructions. Signs include turning the TV up loud, asking people to repeat themselves, or struggling in noisy places. Get your hearing checked; hearing aids help many people. See a doctor promptly for sudden hearing loss in one ear.
ms: Masalah pendengaran biasa berlaku dengan usia dan boleh menyebabkan rasa sunyi dan salah faham, termasuk arahan ubat. Tandanya termasuk menguatkan TV, meminta orang mengulang, atau sukar mendengar di tempat bising. Periksa pendengaran anda; alat bantu dengar membantu ramai orang. Jumpa doktor segera jika pendengaran hilang tiba-tiba pada sebelah telinga.

title: Teeth and gum health
source: WHO: Oral health fact sheet; MOH Malaysia Oral Health Programme
en: Brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste, clean between your teeth, limit sugary drinks and snacks, and see a dentist regularly, including if you wear dentures. Gum disease is more common and harder to control with diabetes, and sore teeth can make eating difficult. See a dentist for bleeding gums, a loose tooth, or a mouth ulcer that hasn't healed in 2 to 3 weeks.
ms: Gosok gigi dua kali sehari dengan ubat gigi berfluorida, bersihkan celah gigi, kurangkan minuman dan snek bergula, dan jumpa doktor gigi secara berkala, termasuk jika memakai gigi palsu. Penyakit gusi lebih biasa dan sukar dikawal bagi pesakit diabetes. Jumpa doktor gigi jika gusi berdarah, gigi goyang, atau ulser mulut tidak sembuh dalam 2 hingga 3 minggu.

title: Bladder leaks (urinary incontinence)
en: Leaking urine is common but not a normal part of ageing, and it can often be improved. Pelvic floor exercises, regular toilet times, and avoiding too much caffeine can help. Don't cut down on drinking water, as that can make it worse and cause infections. Tell your doctor, who can check for causes such as infection, medicines or diabetes.
ms: Kencing tidak lawas adalah biasa tetapi bukan sebahagian normal penuaan, dan selalunya boleh diperbaiki. Senaman otot lantai pelvis, waktu ke tandas yang tetap dan mengurangkan kafein boleh membantu. Jangan kurangkan minum air kerana ia boleh memburukkan keadaan dan menyebabkan jangkitan. Beritahu doktor, yang boleh memeriksa punca seperti jangkitan, ubat atau diabetes.

title: Prostate enlargement (men)
en: Many older men get an enlarged prostate, which can cause a weak flow, difficulty starting, needing to pass urine often, or getting up at night. See a doctor to check the cause and discuss treatment. Get urgent help if you suddenly can't pass urine at all, or if there's blood in your urine.
ms: Ramai lelaki warga emas mengalami pembesaran prostat, yang boleh menyebabkan aliran kencing lemah, sukar memulakan, kerap kencing, atau bangun malam untuk kencing. Jumpa doktor untuk memeriksa punca dan rawatan. Dapatkan bantuan segera jika tiba-tiba langsung tidak boleh kencing, atau ada darah dalam air kencing.

title: Cancer screening
source: MOH Malaysia national screening programmes; WHO
en: Screening finds some cancers early, when treatment works best. Ask your Klinik Kesihatan which checks suit your age and sex, such as breast checks and mammograms, cervical screening with a Pap smear or HPV test, and a stool test for bowel cancer. See a doctor promptly for a new lump, unexplained weight loss, blood in stools or urine, a lasting change in bowel habit, or a cough that won't go away.
ms: Saringan mengesan sesetengah kanser pada peringkat awal, ketika rawatan paling berkesan. Tanya Klinik Kesihatan saringan yang sesuai dengan umur dan jantina anda, seperti pemeriksaan payudara dan mamogram, saringan serviks dengan ujian Pap atau HPV, dan ujian najis untuk kanser usus. Jumpa doktor segera jika ada ketulan baharu, berat badan turun tanpa sebab, darah dalam najis atau air kencing, atau batuk yang tidak hilang.

title: Healthy weight and BMI
source: MOH Malaysia CPG: Management of Obesity; WHO Asian BMI cut-offs
en: BMI is your weight in kilograms divided by your height in metres squared. For Malaysians and other Asian adults, a BMI of 23 to 27.4 counts as overweight and 27.5 or more as obese, because health risks start at lower weights than in Western guidelines. A waist of 90 cm or more in men, or 80 cm or more in women, also raises risk. Losing even 5 to 10 percent of your weight can improve blood sugar and blood pressure.
ms: BMI ialah berat dalam kilogram dibahagi dengan ketinggian dalam meter kuasa dua. Bagi rakyat Malaysia dan orang dewasa Asia, BMI 23 hingga 27.4 dikira berlebihan berat badan dan 27.5 atau lebih dikira obes, kerana risiko kesihatan bermula pada berat yang lebih rendah. Lilitan pinggang 90 cm atau lebih bagi lelaki, atau 80 cm atau lebih bagi wanita, juga meningkatkan risiko. Menurunkan 5 hingga 10 peratus berat badan boleh memperbaiki gula dan tekanan darah.

title: Cutting down salt and sugar
source: WHO: Salt reduction and Sugars intake guidelines; MOH Malaysia
en: WHO recommends less than 5 grams of salt a day, about one teaspoon, including salt already in food. Much of it hides in sauces like kicap, budu and belacan, instant noodles and processed meats. For sugar, keep added sugar well below 10 percent of your daily energy; one can of soft drink can already contain several teaspoons. Ask for 'kurang manis', choose plain water, and taste food before adding salt.
ms: WHO mengesyorkan kurang daripada 5 gram garam sehari, kira-kira satu sudu teh, termasuk garam yang sudah ada dalam makanan. Kebanyakannya tersembunyi dalam sos seperti kicap, budu dan belacan, mi segera dan daging diproses. Bagi gula, pastikan gula tambahan jauh di bawah 10 peratus tenaga harian; satu tin minuman ringan boleh mengandungi beberapa sudu teh gula. Minta 'kurang manis', pilih air kosong, dan rasa makanan sebelum menambah garam.

title: Seizure (fit) first aid
source: NHS: Epilepsy; Epilepsy Society first aid guidance
en: During a seizure, move hard objects away, cushion the head and note the time. Don't hold the person down or put anything in their mouth. When the jerking stops, roll them onto their side and stay with them until they recover. Call 999 if it's their first seizure, if it lasts more than 5 minutes, if another follows quickly, if they're injured, or if they don't wake up.
ms: Semasa sawan, alihkan objek keras, alas kepala dan catat masa. Jangan pegang pesakit dengan kuat atau masukkan apa-apa ke dalam mulutnya. Apabila kejang berhenti, baringkan secara mengiring dan temani sehingga pulih. Hubungi 999 jika ini sawan pertama, berlarutan lebih 5 minit, berulang dengan cepat, pesakit cedera, atau tidak sedar semula.

title: Fainting
en: If someone faints, lay them down and raise their legs if you can. They usually wake within a minute. Call 999 if they don't wake within a minute or two, or if they have chest pain, a fast or irregular heartbeat, difficulty breathing, a head injury, a seizure, or weakness on one side. Anyone who faints for no clear reason, especially an older adult, should see a doctor.
ms: Jika seseorang pengsan, baringkan dan angkat kakinya jika boleh. Biasanya dia sedar dalam seminit. Hubungi 999 jika tidak sedar dalam satu atau dua minit, atau jika ada sakit dada, jantung berdegup laju atau tidak teratur, sukar bernafas, kecederaan kepala, sawan atau lemah sebelah badan. Sesiapa yang pengsan tanpa sebab jelas, terutamanya warga emas, perlu jumpa doktor.

title: Vertigo (room spinning)
en: Vertigo is the feeling that you or the room is spinning. It's often caused by an inner-ear problem and can be brought on by moving your head. Sit or lie down until it passes, get up slowly, and use a light at night to prevent falls. See a doctor if it keeps happening. Call 999 if it comes suddenly with a severe headache, double vision, slurred speech, facial drooping or weakness, as these can be signs of a stroke.
ms: Vertigo ialah rasa anda atau bilik berpusing. Ia selalunya disebabkan masalah telinga dalam dan boleh dicetuskan oleh pergerakan kepala. Duduk atau baring sehingga reda, bangun perlahan-lahan dan nyalakan lampu pada waktu malam untuk mengelak jatuh. Jumpa doktor jika berulang. Hubungi 999 jika berlaku tiba-tiba dengan sakit kepala teruk, penglihatan berganda, pelat, muka senget atau lemah, kerana ini boleh menjadi tanda strok.

title: Swollen legs and blood clots (DVT)
source: NHS: Swollen ankles, feet and legs; NHS: DVT
en: Both ankles swelling a little after sitting or standing a long time is common; raising your legs and walking help. Some medicines, such as amlodipine, can cause it too, so mention it to your doctor. Get help the same day if only one leg is swollen, painful, warm or red, as this can be a blood clot (DVT), especially after surgery or long bed rest. Call 999 if leg swelling comes with chest pain or breathlessness.
ms: Kedua-dua buku lali sedikit bengkak selepas lama duduk atau berdiri adalah biasa; mengangkat kaki dan berjalan membantu. Sesetengah ubat seperti amlodipine juga boleh menyebabkannya, jadi beritahu doktor. Dapatkan rawatan pada hari yang sama jika hanya sebelah kaki bengkak, sakit, panas atau merah, kerana ini boleh jadi darah beku (DVT), terutamanya selepas pembedahan atau lama berbaring. Hubungi 999 jika disertai sakit dada atau sesak nafas.

title: Red, sticky eyes (conjunctivitis)
en: Conjunctivitis makes the eyes red, watery, itchy or sticky, and often clears in 1 to 2 weeks. Clean the eyelids gently with cooled boiled water, wash your hands often and don't share towels. Remove contact lenses until it clears. See a doctor urgently if you have eye pain, sensitivity to light, changes in vision or a very red eye.
ms: Konjunktivitis menyebabkan mata merah, berair, gatal atau melekit, dan selalunya pulih dalam 1 hingga 2 minggu. Bersihkan kelopak mata perlahan-lahan dengan air masak yang disejukkan, kerap basuh tangan dan jangan berkongsi tuala. Tanggalkan kanta lekap sehingga pulih. Jumpa doktor segera jika mata sakit, silau cahaya, penglihatan berubah atau mata sangat merah.

title: Handwashing and preventing infections
en: Washing your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds is one of the best ways to avoid infections. Do it before eating or preparing food, after the toilet, after coughing or sneezing, and before touching a wound or eye drops. Hand sanitiser with at least 60 percent alcohol works when soap isn't available, but not on visibly dirty hands.
ms: Membasuh tangan dengan sabun dan air sekurang-kurangnya 20 saat ialah antara cara terbaik mengelak jangkitan. Lakukan sebelum makan atau menyediakan makanan, selepas ke tandas, selepas batuk atau bersin, dan sebelum menyentuh luka atau ubat titis mata. Pembersih tangan dengan sekurang-kurangnya 60 peratus alkohol boleh digunakan jika tiada sabun, tetapi tidak untuk tangan yang jelas kotor.

title: Preventing dengue at home
source: MOH Malaysia dengue prevention campaigns; WHO Dengue fact sheet
en: Aedes mosquitoes breed in small amounts of clean standing water. At least once a week, empty and scrub flower-pot trays, pet bowls and containers, cover water storage, and clear blocked drains and roof gutters. Use mosquito repellent and long sleeves, especially in early morning and late afternoon, and use screens or nets. See a clinic early for fever during a dengue outbreak.
ms: Nyamuk Aedes membiak dalam air bersih bertakung walaupun sedikit. Sekurang-kurangnya seminggu sekali, kosongkan dan gosok bekas pasu bunga, bekas makanan haiwan dan bekas lain, tutup tempat simpanan air, dan bersihkan longkang serta saluran bumbung yang tersumbat. Guna penghalau nyamuk dan baju lengan panjang, terutamanya awal pagi dan lewat petang. Jumpa klinik awal jika demam semasa wabak denggi.

title: Looking after yourself as a caregiver
source: WHO iSupport for dementia carers; MOH Malaysia Talian HEAL 15555
en: Caring for a family member is meaningful but tiring, and carers often neglect their own health. Share tasks with family where you can, take regular short breaks, keep up your own check-ups, and talk to someone about how you feel. Tell the patient's doctor if you're struggling, as they may know about support services. Talian HEAL 15555 offers emotional support.
ms: Menjaga ahli keluarga sangat bermakna tetapi memenatkan, dan penjaga sering mengabaikan kesihatan sendiri. Kongsi tugas dengan keluarga jika boleh, ambil rehat singkat secara kerap, teruskan pemeriksaan kesihatan anda sendiri, dan berbual dengan seseorang tentang perasaan anda. Beritahu doktor pesakit jika anda menghadapi kesukaran. Talian HEAL 15555 menyediakan sokongan emosi.

title: Herbal products, supplements and fake medicines
source: NPRA (National Pharmaceutical Regulatory Agency) Malaysia; MOH Malaysia
en: Herbal products and supplements can interact with prescription medicines, for example with blood thinners, diabetes or blood pressure medicines. Some products sold online have been found to contain hidden steroids or other drugs. In Malaysia, buy only registered products: look for the MAL registration number and the Meditag hologram on the pack. Always tell your doctor and pharmacist what you take, and don't stop prescribed medicines in favour of herbal remedies.
ms: Produk herba dan suplemen boleh berinteraksi dengan ubat preskripsi, contohnya ubat cair darah, ubat diabetes atau ubat darah tinggi. Sesetengah produk yang dijual dalam talian didapati mengandungi steroid atau ubat lain secara tersembunyi. Di Malaysia, beli produk berdaftar sahaja: cari nombor pendaftaran MAL dan hologram Meditag pada pek. Sentiasa beritahu doktor dan ahli farmasi apa yang anda ambil, dan jangan berhenti ubat preskripsi untuk menggantikannya dengan ubat herba.

title: Bisoprolol, atenolol and other beta-blockers
en: Beta-blockers slow the heart and lower blood pressure. They're used for high blood pressure, angina, heart failure and irregular heartbeat. Side effects can include tiredness, cold hands and feet, or dizziness. Don't stop them suddenly, as this can make heart problems worse. If you have diabetes, they can hide some warning signs of low sugar, such as a fast heartbeat.
ms: Penyekat beta memperlahankan jantung dan merendahkan tekanan darah. Ia digunakan untuk darah tinggi, angina, kegagalan jantung dan degupan tidak teratur. Kesan sampingan termasuk letih, tangan dan kaki sejuk, atau pening. Jangan berhenti tiba-tiba kerana ini boleh memburukkan masalah jantung. Jika anda menghidap diabetes, ia boleh menyembunyikan sesetengah tanda gula rendah, seperti jantung berdebar.

title: Furosemide and other water tablets (diuretics)
en: Water tablets help the body remove extra fluid and lower blood pressure. Take them in the morning, or as directed, so you don't need the toilet all night. They can cause dizziness and dehydration, especially in hot weather or if you have diarrhoea or vomiting; contact your doctor if that happens. Your doctor will check your salts and kidneys with blood tests. If you have heart failure, weigh yourself daily.
ms: Pil air membantu badan membuang cecair berlebihan dan merendahkan tekanan darah. Ambil pada waktu pagi atau seperti diarahkan, supaya tidak perlu ke tandas sepanjang malam. Ia boleh menyebabkan pening dan dehidrasi, terutamanya dalam cuaca panas atau ketika cirit-birit atau muntah; hubungi doktor jika berlaku. Doktor akan memeriksa garam badan dan buah pinggang dengan ujian darah. Jika ada kegagalan jantung, timbang berat setiap hari.

title: Allopurinol (for gout)
en: Allopurinol lowers uric acid to prevent gout attacks over the long term; it does not treat an attack that has already started. Take it after food with plenty of water, every day, even when you feel well. Gout attacks can happen in the first few months while it starts working. Stop it and see a doctor urgently if you get a rash, peeling skin, mouth ulcers or fever.
ms: Allopurinol merendahkan asid urik untuk mencegah serangan gout dalam jangka panjang; ia tidak merawat serangan yang sudah bermula. Ambil selepas makan dengan banyak air, setiap hari, walaupun rasa sihat. Serangan gout masih boleh berlaku pada beberapa bulan pertama. Berhenti dan jumpa doktor segera jika ada ruam, kulit mengelupas, ulser mulut atau demam.

title: Clopidogrel (anti-platelet)
en: Clopidogrel stops blood platelets sticking together, lowering the risk of heart attack and stroke, especially after a stent. You may bruise or bleed more easily. Never stop it without speaking to your heart doctor, particularly after a stent, as this can cause a dangerous clot. Tell dentists and surgeons that you take it. Get urgent help for black stools, vomiting blood or a severe headache.
ms: Clopidogrel menghalang platelet darah melekat, mengurangkan risiko serangan jantung dan strok, terutamanya selepas stent. Anda mungkin lebih mudah lebam atau berdarah. Jangan berhenti tanpa berbincang dengan doktor jantung, terutamanya selepas stent, kerana ia boleh menyebabkan darah beku yang berbahaya. Beritahu doktor gigi dan pakar bedah bahawa anda mengambilnya.

title: Empagliflozin, dapagliflozin (SGLT2 inhibitors)
en: These medicines lower blood sugar by passing extra sugar out in the urine, and they also protect the heart and kidneys. Keep the genital area clean, as thrush and urine infections are more common. Drink enough fluids. If you're unwell with vomiting, diarrhoea or can't eat and drink, ask your doctor or pharmacist whether to pause it for a few days, as there is a rare risk of ketoacidosis.
ms: Ubat-ubat ini merendahkan gula darah dengan membuang gula berlebihan melalui air kencing, dan turut melindungi jantung serta buah pinggang. Pastikan kawasan kemaluan bersih kerana jangkitan kulat dan saluran kencing lebih biasa. Minum air yang cukup. Jika sakit dengan muntah, cirit-birit atau tidak dapat makan dan minum, tanya doktor atau ahli farmasi sama ada perlu berhenti sementara, kerana ada risiko jarang ketoasidosis.

title: Sitagliptin, linagliptin (DPP-4 inhibitors)
en: Gliptins such as sitagliptin and linagliptin help the body release insulin after meals. On their own they rarely cause low blood sugar, but the risk rises when combined with gliclazide or insulin. They are usually well tolerated. Rarely they can cause pancreatitis: seek urgent help for severe, lasting stomach pain that may spread to the back.
ms: Gliptin seperti sitagliptin dan linagliptin membantu badan mengeluarkan insulin selepas makan. Secara sendirian ia jarang menyebabkan gula rendah, tetapi risikonya meningkat jika digabungkan dengan gliclazide atau insulin. Biasanya mudah diterima badan. Jarang-jarang ia boleh menyebabkan radang pankreas: dapatkan bantuan segera jika sakit perut teruk dan berterusan yang mungkin merebak ke belakang.

title: Calcium and vitamin D supplements
en: Calcium and vitamin D supplements are sometimes prescribed for bone health. Calcium carbonate is best taken with food. Calcium can stop some medicines being absorbed, such as levothyroxine, iron and some antibiotics, so take them a few hours apart; your pharmacist can tell you the right gap. Don't take more than recommended, and tell your doctor if you've had kidney stones.
ms: Suplemen kalsium dan vitamin D kadang-kadang dipreskripsi untuk kesihatan tulang. Kalsium karbonat paling baik diambil bersama makanan. Kalsium boleh menghalang penyerapan sesetengah ubat, seperti levothyroxine, zat besi dan sesetengah antibiotik, jadi ambil dengan jarak beberapa jam; ahli farmasi boleh memberitahu jarak yang betul. Jangan ambil melebihi saranan, dan beritahu doktor jika pernah mengalami batu karang.

title: Staying safe when living alone
source: WHO Falls fact sheet; Age UK home safety guidance
en: If you live alone, keep a phone within reach, including in the bathroom and at night, and save emergency numbers such as 999 and a family member at the top. Agree on a daily check-in with someone. Leave a spare key with a trusted neighbour, keep a list of your medicines and conditions near the door for paramedics, and keep floors clear and well lit. Kawan can alert your caregiver if you fall or don't answer.
ms: Jika tinggal seorang diri, pastikan telefon sentiasa dekat, termasuk di bilik air dan pada waktu malam, dan simpan nombor kecemasan seperti 999 dan ahli keluarga di bahagian atas. Tetapkan masa untuk bertanya khabar setiap hari dengan seseorang. Tinggalkan kunci pendua dengan jiran yang dipercayai, simpan senarai ubat dan penyakit dekat pintu untuk paramedik, dan pastikan lantai bersih dan terang. Kawan boleh memaklumkan penjaga anda jika anda jatuh atau tidak menjawab.
